title: Boolean Algebra -- Driven Sepsis Diagnosis
summary: Sepsis remains a diagnostic challenge due to its heterogeneous molecular signatures and complex immune responses. In this study, we develop a logical data analysis framework based on Boolean polynomial rings. This method constructs an ideal $\mathcal{I}$ of selection criteria that isolate empty subsets of previously analyzed patient data. This approach enables the derivation of interpretable classification rules based on biomarker profiles.
